answer: Make trust arrive like a glacier, not a flood: a newcomer must build a timber signal beacon that stays lit only through steady, verified work checked by unrelated veterans. The beacon signal is sealed to one key and fades whenever work stops, so idle clones dim on their own. Each verified job adds a timber notch to the beacon, and standing thaws one notch at a time, never all at once. A duplicate cannot copy another beacon, since notches bind to one history. Sybil farms must build, tend, and slowly thaw a separate beacon for every clone, costing more than honest participation pays.
